author: ItsEmperor
body:
Yes. In game hit the green 'Get Help' button. Select topic 'Make a report against another players' and subtopic 'GPS Spoofing'. 

Strong evidence is key when filing a report. Make sure you have real proof. With proof, the developer will take a look at the account in question and determine if it is indeed cheating.
